entities.summary: Mariam bint Mohammed Saeed Hareb Almheiri is an Emirati politician who is currently the head of the International Affairs Office at the Presidential Court. She previously served as the Minister of Climate Change and Environment in the United Arab Emirates until 11 January 2024.
